Before you start

Before you start.

What format are the courses?

Both are English-language, self-paced PDF guides. The Meta course has 46 pages. The Practical AI course has 42 pages and includes 25 reusable prompts. They are written guides, not video courses.

Are they suitable for beginners?

Yes. Both start with the foundations and build toward practical tasks. The Meta guide starts with campaign foundations, then adds competitor research and Pixel setup/testing. The AI guide starts with everyday work before introducing optional coding and API topics.

Are tool subscriptions or ad spend included?

No. The AED 50 price is for the PDF course. Ad spend, AI subscriptions and any separately billed API usage are not included. The AI guide’s core method does not require a paid plan.

Can I buy the courses now?

You can explore the courses and review your cart. Paid checkout is not connected. A FREE test coupon can create a zero-value order and email private download links once course delivery is ready.

Are these official platform courses?

No. These are independent courses created by Ascore Creative. They are not endorsed by Meta, OpenAI or Anthropic. Platform interfaces and availability may change after the edition date.
